In the Bible, Abraham is commanded by God to sacrifice his son Isaac. After binding Isaac to an altar, a messenger from God stops Abraham before he can complete the sacrifice, stating, 'now I know you fear God'. Abraham then sees a ram and sacrifices it instead. This event is said to have taken place at 'the mount of the LORD'.

In music news, singer Mica released her debut album 'Life in Tangles' in 2000, which sold over 500,000 copies in its first week and was certified Gold by the RIAA. The album's fourth single, 'I Do' featuring André 3000 and Jay-Z, peaked at No. 61 on the Billboard Hot 100. Mica started her music career with Motorcity label in the UK, releasing two solo singles and a duet with Paul Masterson.

In literature, author J.K. Rowling's book 'The Casual Vacancy' received mixed reviews. Critics praised the character development and social commentary, but criticized the pacing and tone. The book follows the events in the fictional English town of Pagford after the death of a parish councillor.

In a passage from 'The Picture of Dorian Gray' by Oscar Wilde, Basil Hallward speaks to Dorian Gray about his painting and the impact it has had on him: 'It changed me; it separated out for ever what was living and what was dead. I realized it was doing so at the time, but not fully, and not how, and not at once. [...] I asked for it, though. If you go down into the darkness, you must expect it to leave traces on you.'
